label: Over twenty thousand dollars offered to each Greenlander, and a fifty fifty vote
description: A major business deal in which the United States offers each citizen of Greenland a sum of over twenty thousand dollars, with a vote coming that splits fifty fifty, the young people excited and the elders wanting to keep living as they always have, something involving the fishing industry, and the minerals as the object, while the president says he will strong-arm them. He says plainly that the vision stopped there and he did not see Greenland become part of America.
aliases: I saw a vote coming, but it was 5050 divided
I didn't see that they became a part of America

label: Over ten thousand fighters infiltrate to take the land
description: Men with longer hair who look as though they are being forced to fight, handed a gun and sent in like jungle warfare, many familiar with the terrain and especially from Cuba, over ten thousand of them trying to infiltrate and take the land and cause havoc for America, extending to Colombia. The headcount is the specific part and a force that size could not move unnoticed.
aliases: I saw over 10,000 people trying to infiltrate
some of them just looked like they were being forced to fight
I saw them uh going in like jungle warfare

label: Certain cryptocurrencies called to go to five dollars
description: A prayer that certain cryptocurrencies flourish and go to five dollars now, called in and called blessed, with the banking deals signed and made unhindered. A named price target is directly checkable against market data, though he does not name the coin here.
aliases: We call certain cryptocurrencies to flourish
GO TO $5 NOW IN JESUS NAME
